description: Ministry of Labour and Trade Union Relations - Revoked the Order published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1921/56 of 02.07.2015 - Appointed Mr. T. E. Santharajan as the arbitrator to the Industrial Dispute between Mr. T. H. Dharmasena and 03 others of the one part and National Savings Bank of the other part
